fact: The Sierra Leone delegation's report to the ECOWAS Parliament says Government introduced the Cyber Crime Act, 2020 bill, which was at Committee Stage.

The national development plan lists the enactment of the Cybercrime Act 2021 among sector milestones and says the Cyber Security Act was enacted to criminalise and prosecute cybercrime including online abuse of children.
The strategy's action table calls for capacity to implement the Cybersecurity and Cybercrimes Act, 2021, treating it as an existing act (document published 2023-01, as_of taken from it).
The strategy says the cybercrime bill drafted in 2018 was signed into law in 2021, and its actions include operationalising the institutions the law sets up (Council, NC3, NCSIRCC, Fund).

The Cyber Security and Crime Act, 2021 was published as a supplement to the Sierra Leone Gazette dated 25 November 2021, setting up a response coordination centre, an advisory council and a fund, and defining offences.
The World Bank concept-stage PID lists the establishment of a Cybercrime Law (2021) as progress, with a Cybersecurity Emergency Response Center still to be set up.
The report says a Freetown councillor was charged under sections 44(1)(b) and 44(2)(b) of the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021.

Sierraloaded reports a Freetown councillor charged with cyberstalking and cyberbullying under the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021, prosecuted at Pademba Road Court, pleading not guilty on a first appearance with bail granted.
Premier News SL reports a man charged under Section 44(1)(a) of Sierra Leone's Cyber Security and Crime Act, 2021, which the court is applying.
Joseph Sesay was arraigned at Pademba Road Court on 5 August 2025 on two counts of cyberstalking under Section 44(1)(a) of the Cyber Security and Crime Act, 2021, and granted bail.
Amnesty International names the Cyber Security and Crime Act 2021 as the law under which Hawa Hunt is prosecuted.
Hawa Hunt was arrested on 22 December 2024 and charged with two counts of transmitting insulting messages via a computer system under the Cybersecurity and Crime Act 2021.
